name: kmdb_benchmark
description: kmdb_benchmark is a dataset designed to evaluate language models' knowledge recall and factual consistency across a range of prompts and items. It measures a model's ability to provide correct factual answers and distinguish between true and false statements. The benchmark is intended for automated, quantitative evaluation of knowledge retention and retrieval in text models.
reputation: Relatively niche dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing use in knowledgeability evaluations.
